8851001.ar: غير الأغاني الشعبية، يا ترى هحب نوع تاني من المزيكا؟
8851001.en: Besides folk songs, will I fall in love with other music as well? I think I will get the answer soon!

8851002.ar: ميكو مبتعرفش غير الغنا ومبتجيش تزورني.
8851002.en: Miko knows nothing but singing, and doesn`t come to see me. I just got a lot of rock band records and wanted to play them for her!

8851003.en: Playing... You can`t help but dance a waltz! But Miko seems uninterested. Try other Record Players!

8851004.en: Play the record... The drumbeats and the guitar hit your heart. Miko`s eyes seem to light up.

8851005.ar: ماريا عازفة جيتار ممتازة بس مش واثقة في نفسها.
8851005.en: Maria`s guitar skills are superb, but she is still not confident in herself.

8851006.en: Go away! No one can take away my lucky guitar!

8851007.ar: كونر يا ابني، كنت عارفة إنه هينجح!
8851007.en: Conner, my child, I knew he would succeed!

8851008.ar: سمعت إن أم كونر بتدوّر عليّا.
8851008.en: I heard that Conner`s mother has been looking for me. She must want to catch me! I won`t be fooled!

8851010.en: After I finished the makeup for Antonio, I went backstage to get Miko`s performance costume. Suddenly I heard a `thud`. I was startled and followed the sound to see the lighting director open the equipment room door. All the stereos inside were gone. When I went backstage, I ran into Conner. He can be my witness.

8851011.en: Before the stereos went missing, I was backstage adjusting the lights. Suddenly I heard a `thud`. I went out to take a look. The door to the equipment room was wide open, and all the stereos inside were gone! Maria, who was rehearsing on stage at the time, can be my witness.

8851012.ar: كنت بلعب في الأوضة اللي جنبها.
8851012.en: After I finished cleaning up the stereos, I went to the next room to rest. Suddenly I heard a `thud`. The door to the equipment room was broken. The lighting director and the makeup artist were talking about something. I was playing games in the next room at the time. You can check my game records.
